name: MCSR6N3
tagline: 12th / 13th Gen Intel six-port appliance with DDR5
description: MCSR6N3 combines Intel 12th / 13th Gen platform options, up to 64GB DDR5, six Intel i226-V 2.5GbE ports, dual M.2 NVMe and dual SATA. DC 12–19V and Type-C PD 19V / 65W input support different power arrangements.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel 12th Alder Lake-U i3-1215U/i5-1235U/i7-1265U; Intel 13th Raptor Lake-U i3-1315U/i5-1335U/i7-1355U/i7-1370P; Intel Pentium Gold 8505

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 1 x HDMI 2.0; 1 x DP1.4; 1 x Type-C

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 2 x SO-DIMM DDR5 5600/5200/4800 MHz, max 64 GB

specs.label: Power
specs.value: DC12~19V Wide Voltage Supply(5.5 x 2.5 mm); 4Pin Type-C PD 19V 65W

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: 1 x COM pin; 1 x 4 Pin CPU Fan Pin; 1 x USB 2.0 Pin; 1 x M.2 SSD2 (PCIEx4); M.2 SSD2 slot supports splitting into 4 x 1 signals

specs.label: BIOS
specs.value: AMI EFI BIOS, supports Power-on after blackout, GPIO, PXE

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: 1 x Power button; 1 x Type-C (USB 4.0); 1 x HDMI 2.0; 2 x USB 3.2; 1 x DP 1.4; 2 x USB 2.0; 1 x CLR CMOS Button; 2 x Wi-Fi antenna reserved hole; 1 x TF Port

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 1 x DC-12V(5.5 x 2.5 mm); 6 x 2.5G Ethernet; 2 x Wi-Fi antenna reserved hole

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 1 x M.2 (PCIE4.0 x 4)NVMe; 1 x M.2 (PCIE3.0 x 4)NVMe; 1 x M.2 E Key WiFi Port; 1 x PANEL POW Pin; 1 x CPU 4Pin Fan Port; 2 x DDR5 RAM Port; 2 x SATA 3.0 Port; 1 x COM Pin; 1 x GPIO Pin

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 2 x M.2 NVMex4; 2 x SATA 3.0; 1 x TF
